versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Proactive Agent Lite, providing core proactive capabilities for AI agents.
- Adds memory architecture for context retention and pre-compaction flush.
- Includes reverse prompting to surface new ideas automatically.
- Implements self-healing patterns for autonomous error diagnosis and recovery.
- Features built-in security hardening and alignment systems for safe, mission-focused operation.
- Seamless integration with all OpenClaw agents; requires OpenClaw v1.0 or higher.
